title: UniFi firewall zone (desired state)
description: A firewall zone as declared in YAML. Member networks are named, not referenced by UUID -- the tool resolves them at runtime, which is what lets two sites' files be structurally identical.

name.description: Zone name. This is the tool's identity for the zone.

networks.description: Names of the networks that belong to this zone. Becomes networkIds. OPTIONAL: membership is one fact with two write paths, this list or the network's own `zone:` in networks.yaml. Declaring it in both places -- even as an empty list, which is a real assertion that the zone is empty -- makes the two files contradict each other, and the next --apply would empty the zones and silently undo segmentation. Use one or the other, never both.

_comment.description: Note for a human reader. Keys beginning with an underscore are stripped before anything is sent to or compared against the console.
